full_prompt_en: A softly shaded digital sticker illustration shows a small child seated with a white cat and an open book, isolated against a warm light gray background. The child sits near the center of the die cut shape, with a round face, tiny dark eyes, rosy cheeks, and a gentle closed mouth smile. A thick halo of curly dark aubergine hair surrounds the head. An orange red sweater curves around the white cat, while deep violet trousers fold into a compact seated pose and small rust colored shoes point outward at the bottom. The cat rises from the book with pointed ears, a simple pale face, and a curling tail; its clean white shape becomes the brightest center of the illustration. Blue violet leaves and rounded foliage grow behind and beside the pair, with a few cream colored mushroom forms tucked into the sides. These decorative plants fill the sticker silhouette while leaving the figures clear. A thick white contour follows the irregular outer edge, and a subtle gray drop shadow lifts the entire cutout from the plain background. The light is even and gentle, with soft internal shading rather than a dramatic source; color shifts give volume to the hair, clothing, and layered leaves. The overall image feels cozy, friendly, and collectible, with compact storytelling contained within a crisp white bordered sticker.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅柔和着色的数字贴纸插画描绘一个小孩坐着与白猫共读一本摊开的书，独立置于温暖的浅灰色背景前。孩子位于模切形状的中央附近，有圆脸、细小的深色眼睛、泛红的脸颊和温柔的闭口微笑。浓密的深茄紫色卷发像光环般围住头部。橙红色毛衣环抱白猫，深紫色裤子折出紧凑的坐姿，底部一双小小的铁锈色鞋子向外伸展。白猫从书本上方探出，尖耳、简洁的浅色面孔和弯曲的尾巴清晰可见；干净的白色形体成为插画最亮的中心。蓝紫色叶片与圆润植物在二者身后及两侧生长，边上还藏着几朵奶油色蘑菇。这些装饰性植物填满贴纸轮廓，同时保持主角清楚。厚实的白色描边沿不规则外缘环绕，微弱的灰色投影让整块剪贴图案从素色背景上轻轻浮起。光线均匀柔和，通过内部的温和明暗而非戏剧性光源来塑形；色彩渐变赋予头发、衣物和叠层叶片体积。整体温馨、友好且有收藏感，把紧凑的故事封装在清晰白边的贴纸里。
style_prompt_en: A compact digital sticker illustration with rounded forms, gentle internal shading, and a crisp irregular white die cut border. Keep the main cluster centered and self contained, with supporting shapes layered closely behind it to enrich the silhouette without confusing the focal point. Use small simple facial or surface marks, soft gradients, muted jewel tones, and a few warm accents. Leave a broad plain neutral field outside the cutout, then add a restrained gray drop shadow to suggest a physical sticker resting above the page. Preserve tidy contours and a friendly handmade feel, with soft light across the entire design rather than a hard directional spotlight. The result should read clearly at small size and feel warm, playful, and collectible.
style_prompt_zh: 采用紧凑的数字贴纸插画语言，运用圆润形体、柔和的内部明暗和清晰的不规则白色模切边。将主视觉簇居中并封闭成形，辅助形状紧密叠在后方，以丰富轮廓而不扰乱焦点。使用少量简洁的表情或表面标记、柔和渐变、含蓄的宝石色与几处暖色点缀。剪贴形状外保留宽阔的素色中性背景，再加克制的灰色投影，暗示实体贴纸轻置于纸面之上。保持轮廓整洁和友好的手作气质，整幅设计以柔光覆盖，而非强硬的定向聚光。结果在小尺寸下仍要清晰，显得温暖、俏皮且值得收藏。
theme_en: Child reading with a white cat sticker
theme_zh: 抱着白猫阅读的孩子贴纸
name: Sticker illustration
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
